title: Adaptive kernel selector and span coalescer for prefill/decode scheduling
creator: Asha Patel
description: Problem: The prefill->decode hotpath generates many short NVTX/trace spans and frequently selects suboptimal kernel variants for mixed-length batches. This produces expensive exporter load and makes per-kernel attribution noisy at p50/p95 across workloads. Goal: implement an adaptive kernel selector that uses lightweight histograms and hardware capability signals to pick the best kernel variant per-request or per-batch, and a span coalescer that reduces span explosion by merging adjacent short-lived spans on the prefill/decode path while preserving enough context for attribution. Deliverables: 1) runtime selector module that exposes kernel.selection_reason and kernel.variant tags; 2) span coalescer that emits coalesced_span_count and original_span_count telemetry; 3) exporter changes to add seq_len_bucket and kernel_invocation_size metrics; 4) Grafana dashboard panels and alerts to detect regressions. Constraints: must be backwards-compatible with existing NVTX naming conventions, have negligible added CPU overhead (<1% on host), and work with current tracing pipeline (Jaeger/OTLP).
comments: 2026-03-02: Initial triage - confirmed high noise on kernel attribution in recent customer incident (INC-2026-11).
2026-03-04: Design sync with runtime team - decided on histogram buckets [1-32,33-128,129-512,>512] to balance fidelity and memory cost.
2026-03-06: Prototype of selector in branch feat/selector-proto - internal microbench shows 3-7% throughput improvement on long-tail sequences.
2026-03-08: Design review notes from @RileyNg: add 'selector.reason' tag with values {batch_size, seq_bucket, hw_capability, fallback} and include a guard to avoid oscillation.
2026-03-09: API review - span coalescer will expose tracing hints but keep existing NVTX spans for full traces under sample rate 0.1.
2026-03-10: Blocked by ENG-50112 (kernel build variants pipeline) for release packaging; opened follow-up subtasks.
acceptance_criteria: Selector emits kernel.variant and selector.reason tags in traces for >90% of sampled prefill/decode requests.
Span coalescer reduces total NVTX span count on mixed workloads by >=10% without increasing p99 latency by >2%.
New per-kernel metrics (invocations, avg_duration_ms, seq_len_bucket) are visible on runtime-1.22 dashboard and have unit tests.
Canary rollout across 10% of hosts shows no regression in memory or CPU and demonstrates improved attribution clarity in Grafana panels.
notes: Implementation approach: selector is a lightweight C++ shim consulted by scheduler, updates per-batch histogram in shared mem; coalescer hooks into trace emitter and merges spans shorter than 150us if adjacent and same kernel id.
Trade-offs: coalescing loses some granularity for tight profiling; mitigation is sampled full tracing and an opt-out env var RH_TRACE_FULL_PREFILL=true.
Observability: add histogram buckets to metrics exporter (seq_bucket label) and add 'coalesced_span_ratio' derived metric for dashboards.
Rollout plan: dev -> internal perf cluster -> canary 10% -> gradual ramp to 100% if no regressions in 48h.
Fallback behavior: selector can force 'safe' kernel variant if kernel build is missing or if runtime detects repeated timeouts; this emits selector.reason=fallback.
